narrative.details:
You've returned triumphant from taming two beasts, it's time now for your last trial. The winds of Zephras whisper of greater challenges ahead.

Take this Taming Rod and journey to the Gustberry Lowlands. There, tame a Vuldren Alpha and prove your mastery.

Complete this lesson and you'll be ready to learn the deeper ways of the hunter.
narrative.objectives: Use the Taming Rod to tame a Vuldren Alpha in the Gustberry Lowlands. Practice your skills, then return the Taming Rod to Quel'ana Quickgale in Valanaar.
narrative.offerRewardText: Excellent, Naanariel! You are quite a fast learner. Now that you know the basics, I can teach you how to forge a lasting bond with an animal companion.Go with this knowledge and thrive. Be the champion that Zephras Isle needs you to be.
narrative.requestItemsText: You will learn, Naanariel, and one day you will be a great champion.

mentionedItems.name: Taming Rod
tooltip: Use: Begins taming a Vuldren Alpha to be your companion for 10 min. If you lose the beast's attention for any reason, the taming process will fail.
